description.en:
DOBOT Atom is a full-size bipedal humanoid designed for industrial manipulation and movement between workstations. Its Neuro-Driven Dexterity System combines binocular vision with learned control for upper-body coordination, targeting activities such as tool use, assembly and handling different object types.

The walking system uses imitation and reinforcement learning to develop humanlike gait and adapt to workplace geometry. DOBOT also describes ROM-1, its robot operator model, as a layer for interpreting and breaking down tasks. Atom therefore combines motion, manipulation and task intelligence in one platform, with practical performance depending on the trained task, end effectors and industrial setup.
